gates.inventory-health-green: Existing vCenter, hosts, vSAN and NSX report healthy before discovery.
gates.vds-ready: Management, vMotion and vSAN VMkernel traffic is on vSphere Distributed Switches.
gates.fleet-attachment-ready: VCF Installer discovery and validation accept the existing vCenter and NSX topology for the target fleet.
gates.wld-import-complete: The existing estate is present in VCF inventory as workload domain chi-wld01.
gates.dr-pair-transition-ready: Recovery plans, protection groups, replications and the paired site are ready for the 9.1 transition.
gates.protection-recovery-91-active: VCF Protection and Recovery 9.1 is active and the former Live Site Recovery and vSphere Replication services are retired.
gates.nsx-upgrade-evaluation-passed: The supported NSX upgrade-path evaluation for 4.2.1.4 to 9.1 passes after import.
gates.nsx-91-precheck-passed: NSX 9.1 is healthy and the vCenter 9.1 interoperability precheck passes.
gates.vcenter-91-active: Workload vCenter 9.1 is active and healthy.
gates.cluster-health-green: Cluster evacuation capacity and hardware compatibility checks pass for the rolling ESXi upgrade.
gates.esxi-91-cluster-complete: Every host in CHI-WLD01-CL01 runs ESXi 9.1.
gates.vsan-resync-zero: vSAN has no active resynchronization and health is green before changing the on-disk format.
